# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Microsoft Edge Updates

How and when Edge updates itself, and that a user cannot postpone it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — SC - Microsoft Edge - D - Updates |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Microsoft_Edge_Updates.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Microsoft_Edge_Updates.json) |

> Two settings added that OpenIntuneBaseline does not set, because without those two a pending Edge update has no hard deadline: the relaunch window (relaunchwindow, 17:00 plus 780 minutes, so 17:00 to 06:00) and accelerated relaunch for a seriously outdated version (relaunchfastifoutdated, 7 days, the lowest value the definition allows). The notification was already set to Required with a period of 3 days; the window ensures that the forced restart falls outside working hours. Note: a device that is off at night only restarts in the next window. Those two are in their own version namespace in the catalog (microsoft_edgev93 for the window, microsoft_edgev141 for the outdated version), whereas the rest of this policy is on microsoft_edge and updatev87/v94/v95; ids verified against the definitions in DCv2/Settings.
